title: Nth Fibonacci Number
description:
Return the nth Fibonacci number (0-indexed: F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(2)=1, F(3)=2, ...).

**Example:**
```
nth_fibonacci(0) → 0
nth_fibonacci(1) → 1
nth_fibonacci(6) → 8
nth_fibonacci(10) → 55
```
hint: Use two variables a, b = 0, 1. Loop n times, updating a, b = b, a+b. Return a.
